steps.title: Extract Total Protein
steps.instruction: Extract proteins from tissues or cell lines using RIPA buffer.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize pancreas or tumor tissues in RIPA buffer containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors using a Dounce homogenizer (Thomas Scientific, NJ).
Lyse cell lines directly in RIPA buffer.
Centrifuge the samples and collect the supernatants for SDS-PAGE analysis.

steps.title: Perform Cytoplasmic and Nuclear Extraction
steps.instruction: Separate cytoplasmic and nuclear fractions from pancreata using sequential buffers.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize pancreata in Buffer A (10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 10 mM KCL, 10 mM NaCl, 0.1 mM EDTA, 0.1 mM EGTA, 1 mM DTT, 0.5 mM PMSF) supplemented with 0.6% NP40.
Centrifuge and collect the cytoplasmic fractions.
Resuspend the resulting pellets in 500 µL Buffer B (20 mM HEPES pH 7.4, Glycerol 20%, KCl 100 mM, EDTA 1 mM, DTT 1 mM, PMSF 0.5 mM, leupeptin 10 ug/mL) supplemented with 1% NP40 and centrifuge again.
Resuspend the final pellets in Buffer C (20 mM HEPES pH 7.4, Glycerol 20%, 400 mM NaCl, EDTA 1 mM, EGTA 1 mM, PMSF 0.5 mM, DTT 1 mM, leupeptin 10 mg/mL) to isolate the nuclear fraction.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate EZH2
steps.instruction: Perform immunoprecipitation of EZH2 from UN-KC6141 cell lysates.

substeps.instruction: Lyse UN-KC6141 cells in RIPA buffer.
Immunoprecipitate 2mg of protein lysate with 2.5mg of anti EZH2 antibody (Abgent, AM1836A) overnight.
Incubate the lysates for 2 hours with 20µl of protein G Dynabeads (Invitrogen #10003D).

steps.title: Perform Serial Co-Immunoprecipitation for EED
steps.instruction: Perform serial co-IP to isolate EED-associated proteins.

substeps.instruction: Immunoprecipitate 2mg of protein lysate with anti EED antibody (E4L6E, Cell Signaling, #85322) overnight.
Incubate the sample for 2 hours with 20µl of protein A Dynabeads (Invitrogen #10008D).

steps.title: Analyze Eluted Proteins
steps.instruction: Analyze eluted proteins via SDS-PAGE using specific antibodies.
